gloss: impulse purchase; buying on the side while shopping for something else

definitions.gloss: impulse purchase; incidental purchase; buying on the side
definitions.explanation: buying additional items while already shopping for something else, often on impulse

examples.japanese: ついで{買|が}いでお{菓子|かし}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought snacks as an impulse purchase.

examples.japanese: レジ{横|よこ}の{商品|しょうひん}はついで{買|が}いを{狙|ねら}っている。
examples.english: Products near the register are targeting impulse purchases.

examples.japanese: ついで{買|が}いを{減|へ}らせば{節約|せつやく}になる。
examples.english: Reducing impulse purchases leads to savings.

notes:
ついで{買|が}い refers to buying extra items incidentally while shopping for something else.

ETYMOLOGY:
ついで (while at it) + {買|が}い (buying)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ついで{買|が}いでお{菓子|かし}を{買|か}う: to buy snacks as an impulse purchase
- ついで{買|が}いを{減|へ}らす: to reduce impulse purchases

MARKETING CONTEXT:
Retailers strategically place items near checkout counters to encourage ついで{買|が}い.

RELATED TERMS:
- {衝動買|しょうどうが}い: impulse buying (more spontaneous)
- まとめ{買|が}い: bulk buying
